scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.test: npm --workspace apps/api run test && npm --workspace apps/web run test
scripts.test:e2e: npm --workspace apps/api run test:e2e && npm --workspace apps/web run test:e2e
scripts.lint: npm run lint:api && npm run lint:web
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace apps/api run typecheck && npm --workspace apps/web run typecheck
